cleanup.postgres: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='zitadel' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid(); DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS zitadel; DROP ROLE IF EXISTS zitadel;

description: Pure cert-only, per-role-CN. postgres/mtls enforces hostssl ... cert (no password). mtls_cns=zitadel\npostgres (= the DB roles, hostname-independent), so addon-mtls issues two client certs (CN=zitadel and CN=postgres). conf-enable-mtls-app.sh splits zitadel.yaml so Database User.SSL -> /certs/mtls/zitadel/ (login role zitadel, auto-created by zitadel via the Admin connection) and Admin.SSL -> /certs/mtls/postgres/ (superuser). zitadel reaching Healthy + /bootstrap/login-client.pat written proves both cert-only connections work end-to-end (no DB password is consulted). stack_name='mtls' shares the postgres/mtls stack so the dependency-host resolver (template 185) matches this zitadel to the postgres/mtls container (not postgres-default) in the full --all suite. Distinct from zitadel/mtls, which is password + verify-ca against postgres/ssl.
